tools.name: annotate_variant
tools.description:
Annotate and classify one human genetic variant using GeneBe.

Start here for any question about a variant (what is it, is it pathogenic/benign, how common is it).
Returns the ACMG verdict with points and criteria, population frequency (gnomAD), predictor scores
(REVEL, AlphaMissense, SpliceAI, ...)

tools.name: explain_acmg_decision_path
tools.description:
Explain step by step why each classification criterion did or did not apply to a variant.

Use after annotate_variant when the user asks "why was this classified that way?". Returns an
ASCII rendering of the decision tree with the evaluated conditions. By default it explains the
germline ACMG verdic

tools.name: convert_variant
tools.description:
Convert a variant written in any notation into normalized hg38 genomic coordinates.

Use when you only need the chr/pos/ref/alt of a variant (for example to translate HGVS or an rsID),
without annotation. Does not classify the variant; use annotate_variant for that.

tools.name: get_variant_effects
tools.description:
List a variant's predicted molecular consequences on every overlapping transcript.

Returns per-transcript HGVS (c. and p.), consequence terms (e.g. missense_variant) and impact,
most severe and MANE Select transcripts first. Lightweight: no frequencies or classification.

tools.name: get_gene
tools.description:
Look up a human gene: identifiers, location, MANE Select transcript, ClinGen gene-disease validity.

Use for questions about a gene rather than a specific variant. Transcripts are listed with
MANE Select first and capped; check total_transcripts.

tools.name: liftover_coordinate
tools.description:
Convert a genomic position, interval or variant between genome builds (hg19, hg38, t2t).

Check `status`: RESOLVED means one result, AMBIGUOUS means several candidates, anything else
means it could not be mapped (see errors). For variants, ref/alt are rebuilt against the target
reference and warning
